title: A Classification of Self-Maps of Generalized Grassmannians
summary: Generalized Grassmannians form a fundamental class of flag manifolds associated with Lie groups. The purpose of this paper is to classify self-maps of generalized Grassmannians of nonzero degree in terms of their induced actions on cohomology. We prove a rigidity theorem showing that, despite the rich and intricate structure of their cohomology rings, the induced cohomology endomorphisms fall into only two natural types: Adams operations determined by the degree and Dynkin symmetries arising from automorphisms of the Dynkin diagram.
